The '''Brotherhood of Independent Scouts''' was an organization formed by independent [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who worked for themselves and were not under the control of either the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] or corporate interests.<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>
